task.title: R1B follow-up A: lane eviction has no non-vacuous mutation evidence
task.objective: src/storage/folderWriteCoordinator.ts advertises, in its own header, that each lane is reference-counted by its pending tasks and removed the moment that count reaches zero - at which point nothing is in flight or queued for that key. Every assertion that currently claims the lane is released correctly compares activeFolderCoordinationKeys() against length === 0 (scripts/verify-r0-characterization.mts:823, :910 and around :944, and scripts/verify-profile-store.mts:727). The 21-red mutation control that those suites rely on was applied to JsonProfileStore.serialize in src/storage/ProfileStore.ts, so under it the coordinator is never called at all and the function returns [] - all four assertions pass VACUOUSLY, and would pass equally against a coordinator that evicts too eagerly. The only non-vacuous eviction evidence anywhere is the single positive control at scripts/verify-write-queue.mts:344-347, which samples the active keys from inside a task that is ALONE on its lane and has never been mutation-tested; folderWriteCoordinator.ts itself has never been mutation-tested and verify:write-queue was not part of the mutation run. The advertised invariant that actually matters - a lane cannot be evicted while work remains QUEUED BEHIND the running task - is therefore not proven by any assertion in the repository. This is a verifier-quality defect, not a product defect: the shipped coordinator is correct. The remedy is the smallest architecture-correct verifier change - one assertion that samples the active keys from INSIDE a task that was admitted while an earlier task was still running, asserting expected lane cardinality and identity BEFORE any absence assertion - proven load-bearing by a real mutation applied to folderWriteCoordinator.ts itself and restored byte-exactly afterwards. Production code must not be changed.

architecture: This is a VERIFIER-QUALITY tranche. src/storage/folderWriteCoordinator.ts is NOT to be changed. It may be mutated transiently to produce mutation evidence and must then be restored byte-exactly, proven by git status reporting it clean.

The sole implementation edit is scripts/verify-write-queue.mts. Do not create a new verifier script, do not add an npm script, and do not add a debug or introspection API to the coordinator - activeFolderCoordinationKeys() is already the sanctioned observation seam and its signature and semantics must not change.

The new check must sample activeFolderCoordinationKeys() from INSIDE a task that was admitted while an earlier task on the SAME key was still running. Block 6d's existing positive control samples from a task that is alone on its lane, which is why it cannot see an eviction that is one task too early.

The queued task MUST be admitted from OUTSIDE the running task's async context. Admitting it from inside the running task's body is rejected by the same-key re-entrancy guard shipped by awkit-utbf (folderWriteCoordinator.ts:116-125) and would prove nothing about eviction. Gate the first task on a deferred promise that is resolved only after the second has been admitted.

Cardinality before emptiness, in that order: first prove the expected lane cardinality and identity while work is queued, only then prove absence after the drain. This is the idiom awkit-utbf already established at scripts/verify-write-queue.mts:457-462 and it is what stops the assertion passing over an empty key set.

Reuse the existing harness helpers - deferred(), drainEventLoop(turns), GATE_DRAIN_TURNS and the bounded settleWithin/Outcome shape - rather than introducing wall-clock delay(ms) waits. Results must not depend on how loaded the host is, and both arms of any gate must terminate.
security: No authorization, licensing, secret-handling, protected-login or signing surface is touched. No IPC channel, permission or sender check changes. No network access.
compatibility: No production behaviour changes at all. folderCoordinationKey, runExclusive and activeFolderCoordinationKeys keep their exact signatures and semantics, and no currently legitimate caller is affected.

No persisted shape change, no migration, no manifest change, no new dependency. verify:write-queue and verify:roadmap-dashboard are already registered in scripts/lib/verifier-classification.ts, so the registry is reconciled rather than extended.
Every pre-existing assertion in verify:write-queue must keep passing. No assertion may be weakened, relaxed into a range, or deleted to produce green.
offline: No network access, no new package dependency, no packaging change.
exclusions: Do NOT repair the fingerprint-harness defect discovered during awkit-utbf. It is separate, remains NOT FIXED, and belongs to its own later task.

Do NOT reopen awkit-utbf in any respect: its completion, QA/QC, acceptance and push evidence are final and must remain byte-for-byte unchanged except for the append-only write_lease.history release record that is inherited residue.

Do NOT change the four vacuous length === 0 sites at scripts/verify-r0-characterization.mts:823, :910 and around :944, or scripts/verify-profile-store.mts:727. They are knowingly left as-is for this tranche, which stages its single non-vacuous control in verify:write-queue.

Do NOT fix gateBoundDominatesAFreeWriter (docs/ai/KNOWN_ISSUES.md:283-287), the coordinator comment-attribution defect (KNOWN_ISSUES.md:288-291), QC finding C (path aliasing splitting a lane), or awkit-9a1l.
Do NOT reopen the folderWriteCoordinator same-key guard, the write-queue same-key tests, mutants M1/M2/M3, the roadmap 6/269 pin, or the AWTKIT.rar false-positive adjudication.
Do NOT create a bookkeeping-only tranche or a bookkeeping-only lease for the inherited residue, and do not reset or discard it.

acceptance.description: verify:write-queue contains an assertion that samples activeFolderCoordinationKeys() from inside a task which was admitted while an earlier task on the same key was still running, and requires the lane to be present with exactly the expected cardinality and identity at that moment. This is the assertion the advertised invariant 'a lane cannot be evicted with work queued behind it' was missing.

The new block proves expected lane cardinality and presence FIRST and eviction timing and absence only afterwards, so no eviction assertion can pass over an empty key set. The queued task is additionally proven to have been genuinely queued - it had not started before the gate was released - so the queued-behind window is actually exercised rather than measured after the first task settled.

The new check was executed and observed FAIL against a coordinator shape that evicts one task too early, before being observed PASS against the shipped coordinator, with the failing assertion name read from the verifier's own output rather than predicted. The baseline total was measured on the live tree first, so the delta is attributed to the added checks and not to pre-existing breakage. No existing assertion was weakened to produce green.

The load-bearing mutation is applied to src/storage/folderWriteCoordinator.ts ITSELF, not to a caller: owned.pending is incremented at task start instead of at admission, so a lane with work queued behind it reaches zero and is evicted early. The mutant compiles, the coordinator actually executes, the verifier terminates normally and prints totals, and the named new assertion turns red while the four pre-existing 6d assertions still pass - which is the direct demonstration that those four were not sufficient. A TypeScript compile error, a timeout with no assertion name, an empty active-key set, a mutation that bypasses the coordinator, and any ProfileStore mutation are all explicitly NOT accepted as evidence.

src/storage/folderWriteCoordinator.ts is restored byte-exactly after the mutation and no mutation remains on disk, confirmed by git status reporting the file clean and by the restored source being re-read. This tranche makes no production change: the characterization proved a verifier defect, not a product defect, so the coordinator is correct as shipped and was deliberately not edited.

npm run build typechecks clean and both neighbouring suites keep every pre-existing assertion passing at or above their measured counts: verify:profile-store, whose ProfileStore.serialize is the coordinator's only production caller, and verify:r0-characterization, which holds the R1B coordination characterizations. Any delta is attributed to a specific check rather than asserted as unchanged when it moved.

The implementation diff touches scripts/verify-write-queue.mts only, staged with an explicit pathspec. No production module is staged, no new verifier or npm script is created, every exclusion in constraints.exclusions is left alone, and no protected owner path enters the index.

The mock-site applicability rule is answered from mock-site/README.md rather than assumed, and the answer is recorded with its exact reason. This evidence item is an applicability DETERMINATION: PASS attests that the determination was executed and returned a definitive answer, and does not assert that mock-site coverage of this boundary exists. No mock-site page is manufactured.

Project state reflects measured reality: awkit-s410 closed in Beads with .beads/issues.jsonl re-exported via bd export -o, KNOWN_ISSUES' QC finding A entry moved from open finding to resolved with LIVE line numbers rather than the stale :80/:95 the bead and the finding both cite, CURRENT_STATE and HANDOFF appended while the newest section continues to state the unchanged 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED tally across 67 cases, and TASK_LOG appended. Tracker counts are measured, never assumed, and dependency-blocked is kept strictly distinct from status = blocked. verify:roadmap-dashboard is run BEFORE its non-vacuity pin is touched; any pin movement is routed to QA because the verifier is QA-owned, changed only in the stale exact baseline, mutation-tested, re-run, and kept an exact equality rather than relaxed into a range - with the Overview banner read from the verifier's own executed output.

Non-vacuity of the tranche's premise is now measured rather than argued: all four pre-existing 6d lane-lifetime assertions PASSED under this mutation ('no lane exists for a folder nothing has written to', 'the lane is live while its task is running', 'the lane is evicted once it has nothing left to coordinate', 'a folder written again after eviction is coordinated again'), as did every assertion in sections 1-5 and 6a-6f.
